caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man with curly hair, dressed in a suit jacket, shirt, bow tie, and waistcoat, all rendered in shades of brown. The bust is encircled at the base by a draped piece of cloth or sash in a rich, deep red color, which wraps around the shoulders and forms a rounded shape beneath the figure. The background is a plain, off-white color. The drawing appears to be done with colored pencils or similar media, emphasizing texture and shading, particularly in the facial features, hair, and folds of the clothing and red cloth.
title: Ship's Sternpiece
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
